notes: SR115 Juttu Home (juttu.be). Checked main nav (all 8 top-level items and their mega-menus), homepage banners, and the full category sitemap (https://www.juttu.be/sitemap/category-1.xml) for Clearance/Outlet/Opruiming/Solden/Eindereeks/Laatste-kans equivalents. No node named Outlet, Opruiming, Eindereeks, Laatste kans, or Destock exists anywhere in the nav or sitemap. Two discount-themed pages were found and inspected, and both were EXCLUDED per the Sale-vs-Clearance rule: (1) https://www.juttu.be/nl/c/korting-for-ju.html (og:title 'Korting for ju', on-page <title>/page heading 'Solden: kortingen tot -70%' = 'Sale: discounts up to -70%'; og:description 'Profiteer nu al van kortingen op onze collecties fashion, deco & food... al onze stuks in afprijzing' = 'Take advantage now of discounts on our fashion, deco & food collections... all items marked down'; itemCount 364). 'Solden' is the legal/cultural term for Belgium's biannual seasonal sales period (winter/summer) - this is explicitly a temporary seasonal sale campaign, not a permanent outlet/clearance listing; sitemap also lists graduated sibling pages '10-korting-for-ju.html' and department variants (dames/heren/home-deco/heerlijk-tafelen/verzorging/kerstdecoratie), consistent with a seasonal percent-off promo tiering, not clearance merchandising. (2) https://www.juttu.be/nl/c/promoties.html (og:title empty, category label 'Promoties'='Promotions', og:description 'Ontdek onze ruime collectie Promoties'; itemCount 3654, i.e. most of the entire catalog) - a generic sitewide promotions/discounts landing page, explicitly matching the brief's EXCLUDE example (Promotions/Discounts pages are not automatically Clearance). Neither page uses any clearance/outlet/final-sale/end-of-line language on the site's own taxonomy or copy. No genuine Clearance-type PLP was found after this investigation.
